detail.longDescription: Why Most AI POCs Stall and How to Build an AI Operating Model That Works Companies are generating more AI ideas, hackathons, and proof-of-concepts than ever before. Yet only a small fraction of those initiatives ever become secure, scalable, and widely adopted production solutions. The challenge isn't a lack of innovation or model capability. It's the absence of an AI operating model that connects governance, data readiness, measurement, accountability, and people enablement. In this article, I explore why most AI POCs stall and what organizations can do differently to consistently transform AI experiments into measurable business value. https:// bhavingandhi.com/2026/08/26/wh y-most-ai-pocs-stall-and-how-to-build-an-ai-operating-model-that-works/
